title: GST & HSN product review
explanation: Review up to 25 variants at a time. Blank means not set; 0% is an explicit rate. This changes future bills only, not historical invoices. Confirm classifications with your accountant.
sharedHsn: HSN belongs to the product: changing it affects every variant of that product, including variants on other pages. GST rate and quantity are variant-specific.
discardPrompt: Discard the unsaved tax edits and close?
failed: Could not load or save tax details. Your edits are preserved. Reload after a conflict.
saved: Tax details saved. Historical invoices are unchanged.
stillIncomplete: Some tax facts remain missing. Review before GST billing or CA exports.
invalid: Check HSN (4, 6 or 8 digits), GST (0–100, up to 2 decimals), units and positive base quantity (up to 3 decimals).
